blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.
blocks.zh: 印度历史公共档案提出了严重的计算机视觉和文件图像分析挑战:数十年的议会记录仅能作为退化、多栏扫描的网页而活下来,这些网页以混合的文字、复杂的布局和密集的视觉噪音为主,而OCR故障是信息检索的主要障碍。 我们提出一个端到端框架,即夫妇基于视觉的布局分化和多写式OCR,并配有代理取回-增强生成(RAG)管道。 我们的方法专门涉及视觉退化和布局破碎如何传播到文本提取错误中,使用迭代代理环绕OCR噪声和布局模糊而后再生成答案. 根据20万页的旁遮普Vidhan Sabha档案, 我们的系统显示,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Historical legislative archives are difficult to process because the main challenge is often the document image itself. Faded text, irregular layouts, marginal notes, and mixed scripts can introduce errors during layout analysis and OCR, which then propagate to retrieval and question answering [ 29 , 22 , 23 ] . This is particularly challenging for large archives containing Hindi, Punjabi, and English documents with varying print quality and complex layouts.
blocks.zh: 历史立法档案很难处理,因为主要的挑战往往是文件形象本身。 花纹文字,不规则布局,边框音符,以及混合脚本在布局分析和OCR时可以引入错误,然后传播给检索和提问回答[29,22,23]. 这对包含印地语、旁遮普语和英语文件的大型档案来说尤其具有挑战性,其印刷质量和布局各不相同。

blocks.en: Rather than treating OCR as a separate preprocessing step, we study the complete pipeline from document images to retrieval and answer generation. Our framework combines layout-aware OCR with an agentic retrieval loop that can check the retrieved evidence, reformulate the query, and search again when the available context is insufficient. This helps keep generated answers grounded in the original document evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们不把OCR作为单独的预处理步骤,而是研究从文件图像到检索和回答生成的完整管道。 我们的框架将布局感知OCR与代理检索循环相结合,可以检查检索到的证据,重新整理查询,并在可用上下文不足时再次搜索. 这有助于保持基于原始文件证据的生成答案。

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) was introduced to combine language models with external knowledge sources [ 14 ] and has since been extended to iterative and agent-based retrieval [ 9 , 25 , 21 ] . Recent document retrieval methods have also moved toward vision-based representations, reducing reliance on OCR for document retrieval [ 8 , 19 ] . Multi-page document understanding further shows the importance of preserving visual information during retrieval and reasoning [ 7 ] . At the same time, OCR benchmarks have shown that multimodal language models still face difficulties with text recognition, particularly for multilingual and visually challenging documents [ 18 ] , while recent work demonstrates that OCR errors can significantly affect downstream question answering [ 22 ] . Language-model-based OCR correction has therefore become an active research direction, especially for historical documents [ 3 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 引入了检索式生成(RAG),将语言模型与外部知识来源相结合[14],此后扩展至迭代和代理检索[9,25,21]. 最近的文件检索方法也转向了基于愿景的表述,减少了对OCR文件检索的依赖[8,19]. 多页文件理解进一步表明在检索和推理过程中保存视觉信息的重要性[7]. 同时,OCR基准表明,多式联运模式在文本识别方面仍然面临困难,特别是在多语种和视觉挑战性文件[18]方面,而最近的工作表明OCR错误可显著影响下游问题的回答[22]. 因此,基于语言模型的OCR校正已经成为积极的研究方向,特别是历史文献[3,26].

blocks.en: These developments motivate an end-to-end approach for historical legislative archives in which visual processing, retrieval, and answer generation are evaluated together. We focus on the Punjab Vidhan Sabha proceedings, a large multilingual archive spanning 1950–2024. Our system uses open-weight models throughout the pipeline so that the complete workflow can be deployed locally and the retrieved evidence can be traced back to the source pages.
blocks.zh: 这些事态发展促使对历史立法档案采取端到端办法,将视觉处理、检索和答题生成工作一起评估。 我们专注于旁遮普省(Punjab Vidhan Sabha)的诉讼程序, 我们的系统在整个输油管中采用开放重量模型,这样整个工作流程就能够在当地部署,并可以将检索到的证据追溯到源页面.

blocks.en: In this paper, we contribute: • an agentic RAG framework that combines layout-aware OCR, hybrid retrieval, and iterative evidence checking for a multilingual legislative archive; • an evaluation of cross-lingual question answering on a large-scale historical document collection; • an analysis of how OCR and layout errors affect retrieval and answer quality, together with an ablation of the agentic retrieval loop.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们的贡献是:一个代理RAG框架,将布局意识OCR,混合检索和迭代证据核对多语种立法档案结合起来;对大规模历史文件收集的跨语言问题回答的评价;分析OCR和布局错误如何影响检索和回答质量,同时取消代理检索循环.

blocks.en: an agentic RAG framework that combines layout-aware OCR, hybrid retrieval, and iterative evidence checking for a multilingual legislative archive;
blocks.zh: a. 一种代理式的RAG框架,将布局-认识OCR、混合检索和迭代证据检查结合起来,以建立一个多语种立法档案;

blocks.en: an evaluation of cross-lingual question answering on a large-scale historical document collection;
blocks.zh: 对大规模历史文件汇编的跨语言问答进行评估;

blocks.en: an analysis of how OCR and layout errors affect retrieval and answer quality, together with an ablation of the agentic retrieval loop.
blocks.zh: 分析OCR和布局错误如何影响检索和答答质量,同时对代理检索循环进行减缩。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Work on multilingual archive navigation sits at the intersection of several distinct lines of research: retrieval-augmented generation, agentic search, multilingual text embeddings, and multimodal document retrieval. None of these paradigms were originally optimized for a corpus precisely like ours, making it necessary to examine their contributions and limitations regarding noisy, multi-script legislative archives.
blocks.zh: 有关多语种档案导航的工作处于若干不同研究线的交汇点:检索-增强生成、代理搜索、多语种文本嵌入和多式联运文件检索。 这些范式最初没有一个像我们那样被优化为一个实体,因此有必要审查它们在吵闹的多文字立法档案方面的贡献和局限性。

blocks.en: 2.1 Agentic and Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 代理和多种语言检索增强型

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation originated from the premise that language models perform better when granted access to external knowledge rather than depending solely on parametric memory [ 14 ] . Gao et al. categorize RAG frameworks into naive, advanced, and modular designs, emphasizing that iterative query reformulation yields greater accuracy gains than merely scaling retriever capacity [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 检索增强的生成来源于一个前提,即语言模型在获得外部知识时表现更好,而不仅仅依赖于参数内存[14]. 高 et等. 将RAG框架分为天真,先进和模块化的设计,强调迭代查询重构比仅仅缩放检索器容量更能产生准确性收益[9].

blocks.en: Agentic RAG advances this by treating retrieval as an adaptive, multi-step agent loop rather than a static query-response pipeline [ 25 , 21 ] . Architectures that dynamically navigate between keyword indexing, dense semantic search, and document-level browsing offer crucial flexibility for decades-old legislative records [ 1 ] . While agentic orchestration has been successfully demonstrated on historical collections like the CIA’s declassified archives, those implementations typically remained monolingual without addressing script-switching constraints [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 代理RAG将检索视为一个适应性的多步骤代理循环,而不是静态查询-答复管道[25,21],从而推进了这一点. 动态导航关键词索引、语义检索和文件级浏览之间的结构,为数十年的立法记录提供了至关重要的灵活性[1]。 虽然CIA解密档案等历史档案中成功地展示了代理式的管弦乐,但这些执行通常仍然是单一语言的,没有解决脚本切换的限制[4]。

blocks.en: Cross-lingual and multilingual RAG present distinct structural hurdles. Chirkova et al. demonstrated that maintaining output consistency requires robust prompt design rather than auxiliary translation steps [ 6 ] , while Liu et al. observed performance degradation in cross-lingual retrieval tasks [ 16 ] . Conversely, Li et al. highlighted that incorporating multilingual evidence can stabilize reasoning in ambiguous contexts [ 15 ] . Influenced by these findings, our system indexes Hindi, Punjabi, and English sources concurrently. Foundation models such as Multilingual-E5-Large provide strong cross-lingual mappings, serving as an important precedent for our multi-script workflow [ 28 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 跨语言和多语言的RAG具有明显的结构障碍。 Chirkova等人著. 证明保持产出一致性需要强有力的即时设计而不是辅助翻译步骤[6],而Liu et al. 在跨语言检索任务中观察到性能退化[16]. 相反, 李等编. 强调纳入多语种证据可在不明确的情况下稳定推理 [15] 。 受这些调查结果的影响,我们的系统同时索引印地语、旁遮普语和英语来源。 多语种-E5-Large等基础模型提供了强大的跨语言绘图,成为我们多语种工作流程的重要先例[28,24].

blocks.en: 2.2 OCR and Historical Multilingual Document Processing
blocks.zh: 2.2 OCR和历史多语言文件处理

blocks.en: Historical document retrieval requires careful accounting for OCR degradation. Zhang et al. quantified how noise introduced during text extraction degrades downstream RAG performance [ 29 ] , and Piryani et al. showed that these errors compound significantly in non-Latin and multi-script environments like Punjabi Gurmukhi and Hindi Devanagari [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 历史文件的检索需要对OCR退化进行认真的核算. Zhang等人量化了在文本提取过程中引入的噪声如何降解下游RAG性能[29],Piryani等人. 显示这些错误在旁遮普语Gurmukhi和印地语Devanagari等非拉丁语和多标语环境中严重复合[22].

blocks.en: Recent post-correction methodologies utilize LLMs to clean historical text and generalize better than traditional sequence models [ 26 ] . Bourne demonstrated that injecting domain-specific historical context further improves entity recognition for specialized legislative terminology [ 3 ] . Romein et al. confirm that structurally complex, multi-script documents remain a primary challenge in AI-assisted archive digitization [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 近期的校正后方法利用LLMs来清理历史文本,并比传统序列模型更通俗化[26]. Bourne表明,注射领域特定历史背景进一步提高了实体对专门立法术语的承认[3]。 Romein等人证实,结构复杂、多写文件仍然是AI协助的档案数字化方面的主要挑战[23]。

blocks.en: 2.3 Multimodal and Vision-Language Document Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.3 多式和远景-语言文件检索

blocks.en: Traditional text-only pipelines often discard critical page layout structures such as tables, headers, and column boundaries, motivating a shift toward multimodal document retrieval. Ma et al. review this paradigm shift toward vision-language document encodings [ 20 ] . Frameworks such as ColPali [ 8 ] , DSE [ 19 ] , and advanced visual embedding architectures like NetraEmbed [ 13 ] encode document images directly into dense vector spaces, preserving layout semantics and layout structures across multiple languages. Cho et al. extended this to multi-page retrieval frameworks [ 7 ] , while Liu et al. emphasize the integration of sparse lexical search with dense visual embeddings as an optimal trajectory for complex document repositories [ 17 ] . Our optimized pipeline leverages these insights by pairing robust multilingual textual dense representations with an adaptive agentic loop tailored for historical legislative document search.
blocks.zh: 传统的只有文本的管道往往丢弃重要的页面布局结构,如表格、页眉和列边框,促使人们转向多模式文件检索。 Ma等人回顾了这种向视觉语言文件编码的范式转变[20]. ColPali [8],DSE [19]等框架,以及NetraEmbed [13] 等高级视觉嵌入架构将文档图像直接编码成密集的矢量空间,保留布局语义和多种语言的布局结构. Cho等人 (英语). 将其扩展至多页检索框架[7],而Liu et al. 强调将稀疏的词汇搜索与密集的视觉嵌入相结合,作为复杂文件存储库的最佳轨迹[17]. 我们优化的管道利用这些见解,将强力的多语种文字密集表述与适合历史立法文件搜索的适应性代理循环结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Query Management and Multi-Lingual Processing
blocks.zh: 3.1 查询管理和多语言处理

blocks.en: The system initiates by receiving a user query, denoted as q q , in its native script and language. Rather than relying on intermediate machine translation, our architecture processes the query natively against a multilingual semantic vector space, preserving domain-specific legislative terminology and regional context across Hindi, Punjabi, and English. Fig. 1 shows the pipeline: the query is embedded natively, the agent loop checks context sufficiency and rewrites the query if needed, and the generator produces the grounded answer.
blocks.zh: 系统通过接收用户查询启动,其原生文字和语言表示为qq. 我们的架构不依靠中间机器翻译,而是用本地语言处理对多语种语义矢量空间的查询,在印地语、旁遮普语和英语中保留特定域的立法术语和区域背景。 图1显示了管道:查询是本土嵌入的,代理循环检查上下文是否充足,如果需要则重写查询,生成者会生成被基于的答案.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Architecture of the proposed Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. The framework features multi-lingual query processing, an iterative LLM-driven evaluation loop to ensure context sufficiency, and a grounded response generation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图 1:拟议的代理检索-增强生成系统的结构。 该框架的特点是多种语言的查询处理、确保上下文充足性的LLM驱动的迭代评价循环,以及基于底底的反应生成管道。

blocks.en: 3.5 Algorithm: Native-Language Agentic RAG Loop
blocks.zh: 3.5 算法:原生语言代理RAG Loop

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Native-Language Multi-Step Agentic Retrieval
blocks.zh: 算法 1 本地语言多步代理检索

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: The dataset used in this research consists of Punjab Vidhan Sabha (legislative assembly of Punjab state) documents collected from archival records spanning from the 1950s to 2024. The collection includes assembly proceedings, debates, reports, notices, and other official legislative documents published across different time periods.
blocks.zh: 这项研究所用的数据集包括从1950年代至2024年的档案记录中收集的旁遮普省立法大会文件。 该汇编包括集会程序、辩论、报告、通知以及在不同时期发表的其他正式立法文件。

blocks.en: The records were digitized from bound volumes held by [ https://pvs.neva.gov.in/ ], a process that was carried out incrementally over several decades rather than in a single digitization effort. This matters for the corpus’s characteristics: pages from the 1950s and 1960s were typically typeset on older printing equipment and later scanned at lower resolution, often with visible ink bleed-through, faded typeface, and skewed page boundaries, while more recent decades (post-2020) are comparatively cleaner but still exhibit dense multi-column layouts and inconsistent formatting across sessions.
blocks.zh: 记录从[https://pvs.neva.gov.in/]所持的装订卷中数字化,这一过程在几十年中逐步进行,而不是在一次数字化努力中进行。 这一点对本文书的特性很重要:1950年代和1960年代的页数通常排在较旧的印刷设备上,后来用更低的分辨率扫描,往往有明显的墨血、淡化的排字面和扭曲的页数界限,而最近几十年(2020年后)相对比较干净,但仍显示出密集的多栏布局和不同会议的格式不一致。

blocks.en: Documents in the corpus are predominantly in Hindi (Devanagari) and Punjabi (Gurmukhi), with English appearing throughout, particularly in earlier-era records and administrative headers; it is common for a single page to mix two or all three languages, for instance an English-language question header followed by a Punjabi response, or bilingual tabular data. The collection totals approximately 200,000 pages a covering assembly sessions, starred and unstarred questions, budget and financial statements, committee reports, and procedural notices. Fig. 2 shows representative pages illustrating the multi-column layouts, mixed scripts, and visual degradation typical of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 案卷中的文件主要以印地语(Devanagari)和旁遮普语(Gurmukhi)为主,英文一直出现,特别是在早期的记录和行政标题中;一个单页通常混合两种或所有三种语言,例如英文问题头,然后是旁遮普语答复,或者双语表格数据。 该汇编共约20万页,包括各届大会、重点问题和无重点问题、预算和财务报表、委员会报告和程序通知。 图2显示了代表性的页面,说明了多栏布局,混合脚本,以及典型的神体视觉退化.

blocks.en: Given the scale of the archive, we did not attempt to hand-annotate the full collection. Instead, we constructed a stratified evaluation benchmark of 1,000 pages and 200 gold-annotated question-answer pairs, sampled to balance representation across decade, script, and document type, so that evaluation results reflect the corpus’s actual heterogeneity rather than only its cleaner, more recent portion. To isolate the contribution of the vision pipeline specifically, we additionally hand-transcribed a smaller subset of 20 pages, selected to span a range of degradation levels, as ground truth for OCR quality evaluation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于档案的规模,我们没有试图手表 完整的收藏。 相反,我们构建了1 000页的分层评价基准和200个注解的金质问答对等基准,抽样以平衡整个十年中的代表性、文字和文件类型,从而使评价结果反映本体的实际异质性,而不仅仅是其较清洁的最新部分。 为了具体隔离远景规划的贡献,我们又手写了一个20页的较小的子集,被选定涵盖一系列退化程度,作为OCR质量评价的地面真相。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of dataset pages featuring tabular data, multi-scripts, and faded text characteristics.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 以表格数据为主的数据集页面概览,多标注,以及淡出文本特征.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置

blocks.en: We ran our experiments on a single Nvidia RTX-4060 (16 GB VRAM). Our evaluation framework implemented a robust local storage backend using ChromaDB alongside an adaptive agentic retrieval architecture driven by BAAI/bge-m3 for dense and hybrid token-level multilingual embeddings (supporting English, Punjabi Gurmukhi, and Hindi Devanagari).
blocks.zh: 我们运行了单Nvidia RTX-4060(16GB VRAM)的实验. 我们的评价框架利用ChromaDB, 以及BAAI/bge-m3驱动的适应性代理检索架构,

blocks.en: As described in Section 3.5 , the retrieval index spans the full 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive. All quantitative results in this section are computed against our stratified evaluation benchmark of 1,000 pages and 200 gold-annotated queries, drawn from this corpus and balanced across decade, script, and document type. Additionally, to isolate vision-side performance, we hand-transcribed a subset of 20 pages and evaluated multiple layout segmentation and OCR model combinations against this ground truth.
blocks.zh: 正如第3.5节所述,检索指数跨越了20万页的Punjab Vidhan Sabha档案。 本节中的所有量化结果都是根据我们分级评估的基准,即1 000页和200个黄金附加说明的询问进行计算,这些询问来自本目录,在十年、文字和文件类型之间是平衡的。 此外,为了孤立视觉-侧面的性能,我们手绘了20页的子集,并根据这一地面真理评价了多个布局分区和OCR模型组合.

blocks.en: 4.4 Retrieval Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.4 检索业绩比较

blocks.en: Our primary goal was to evaluate and compare the retrieval performance of various multilingual embedding models and our proposed optimization framework on the domain-specific Punjab Vidhan Sabha (PVS) benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要目标是评价和比较各种多语种嵌入模型的检索绩效,以及我们针对特定域的旁遮普-维丹-萨卜哈基准提出的优化框架。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , token-level and smaller cross-lingual models like MuRIL and LaBSE struggle heavily with the complex, multi-script historical documents, yielding near-zero or low MRR@1 scores. Larger dense retrievers such as Multilingual-E5-Large and NetraEmbed scale better, achieving Hit@3 scores above 0.81. However, BGE-M3 and our optimized pipeline establish the strongest baseline and performance standard, successfully navigating historical OCR degradation and mixed-script text to secure top-tier retrieval accuracy.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,像MuRIL和LaBSE这样的符号级和较小的跨语言模型与复杂,多标本的历史文档发生激烈斗争,产生接近零或低的MRR@1分数. 多语言-E5-Large 和 NetraEmbed 等密度较大的检索器,达到Hit@3分高于0.81分. 然而,BGE-M3和我们优化的管道建立了最强的基准和性能标准,成功导航了历史上的OCR退化和混合标注文本,以确保顶级检索精度.

The same Punjabi query is given to multilingual-e5-large, BGE-M3, LaBSE, Netra embedding (2560 dimensions), and EmbeddingGemma-300M. The retrieved document from each model is compared with the ground-truth relevant document shown in the rightmost column. The retrieved results demonstrate differences in cross-lingual semantic matching, with several models returning visually and semantically unrelated legislative records. In contrast, our proposed system retrieves the relevant document containing the required information, demonstrating its effectiveness for retrieval from multilingual historical archives.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation on Agent Loop Iterations
blocks.zh: 5.2 代理循环迭代

blocks.en: To quantify the contribution of the iterative agentic loop, we vary the maximum number of retrieval–rewrite iterations using a fixed 200-query evaluation dataset, L ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } L\in\{1,2,3\} , and measure retrieval quality (MRR@1, Precision@3) alongside end-to-end answer correctness (Answer F1-Score) on the same 200-query benchmark. L = 1 L=1 corresponds to a single-pass, non-agentic retrieval baseline with no query rewriting.Fig. 5 illustrates how iterative query rewriting corrects retrieval errors. In the first two iterations, the system retrieves irrelevant documents, but after further query refinement, the third iteration successfully retrieves the correct document containing the required information.
blocks.zh: 为了量化迭代代理环路的贡献, 我们使用固定的 200 query 评价数据集 L {} { 1 , 2 , 3} L\ in { 1, 2, 2} , 并在同一 200 query 基准上, 与 端对端 答案正确性 (Answer F1-Score) 一起测量 检索质量 (MRR@ 1, Precent@3) 。 L = 1 L = 1对应一个单通道,非代理检索基线,没有查询重写. 图5说明了迭代查询重写如何纠正检索错误. 在前两个迭代中,系统检索不相关的文档,但在进一步查询完善后,第三个迭代成功检索包含所需信息的正确文档.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 7 , increasing L L from 1 to 3 improves MRR@1 from approximately 0.89 to 0.97 and Precision@3 from approximately 0.33 to 0.37, but the effect is most pronounced on Answer F1-Score, which rises from approximately 0.18 to 0.35 — nearly a 2 × 2\times relative gain. This asymmetry indicates that the agentic loop’s primary benefit is not marginal re-ranking of already-retrieved passages, but recovering answer-relevant context that single-pass retrieval misses entirely, consistent with our claim that iterative query reformulation is essential for navigating OCR noise and layout ambiguity in this corpus.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,将LL从1增加到3,使MRR@1从约0.89增加到0.97,精密@3从约0.33增加到0.37,但效果对Answer F1-Score最为明显,它从约0.18增加到0.35——几乎是2×2\的相对收益。 这种不对称现象表明,代理循环的主要好处不是对已经获取的段落进行边缘的重新排序,而是恢复与答案相关的上下文,即单行道检索完全缺失,这与我们的说法是一致的,即迭代查询重构对于导航这个实体中的OCR噪声和布局模糊性至关重要。

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制

blocks.en: Despite the strong performance of our multilingual agentic RAG framework, several limitations remain. Severe OCR errors in degraded pages can still affect dense retrieval and entity matching. The iterative agentic loop and LLM-based sufficiency checks also increase inference latency compared with standard retrieval. In addition, complex financial tables and unstructured tabular data may lose hierarchical structure during text-to-chunk conversion. Future work will focus on improving OCR robustness, reducing inference latency, and preserving complex table structures.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的多语种区域咨询小组框架表现良好,但仍有一些局限性。 退化页面中严重的OCR错误仍然可能影响密集的检索和实体匹配. 与标准检索相比,迭代代理循环和基于LLM的充足性检查也增加了推论延迟性. 此外,复杂的财务表和无结构的表格数据在文本切换过程中可能会失去层次结构. 今后的工作将侧重于提高OCR的稳健性,减少推论延迟性,并保留复杂的桌架结构.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced an Agentic-RAG framework designed to bridge the gap between complex historical archives and user information needs. By blending iterative query rewriting, adaptive document retrieval, and vision-language generation, our approach effectively tackles the nuances of multilingual document search.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们采用了Agentic-RAG框架,旨在弥合复杂的历史档案与用户信息需求之间的差距。 通过混合迭代查询重写、适应性文件检索和视觉语言生成,我们的方法有效地解决了多语文文件搜索的细微差别。

blocks.en: Evaluated on the Punjab Vidhan Sabha debates dataset—a challenging collection spanning multiple decades in Punjabi, Hindi, and English—the system demonstrated robust resilience against real-world hurdles such as historical vocabulary shifts, degraded text, and severe OCR noise. Unlike traditional, rigid RAG pipelines, the iterative loop implemented here acts as a self-correcting mechanism, dynamically verifying context sufficiency to minimize hallucinations and ground final answers directly in source material.
blocks.zh: 对旁遮普语Vidhan Sabha辩论数据集(这集在旁遮普语、印地语和英语中具有挑战性)的评价显示, 与传统的僵硬的RAG管道不同,这里实施的迭代循环起到自我校正机制的作用,动态地验证上下文的充分性,以尽量减少幻觉和源材料直接的地面最终答案.

blocks.en: Ultimately, this study highlights that agentic workflows can significantly enhance information discovery in multilingual public records. Beyond historical text exploration, the principles demonstrated here pave the way for more dependable, transparent, and accessible digital archives for researchers, policymakers, and the public.
blocks.zh: 最终,本研究强调代理工作流程可以大大加强多语种公共记录中的信息发现. 除了历史文本探索之外,在此展示的原则为研究人员、决策者和公众更可靠、更透明和更方便使用的数字档案铺平了道路。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on multi modal retrieval, expanding the system to more Indian languages and government archives, and supporting conversational search with long-context reasoning. User studies with researchers and other archive users will further evaluate its usability and reliability.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于多模式检索,将系统扩大到更多的印度语言和政府档案,并支持以长文推理进行对话搜索。 与研究人员和其他档案用户进行的用户研究将进一步评价其可用性和可靠性。
